title: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Kerala's government-funded health protection programme aligned with PM-JAY, providing cashless hospitalization for eligible beneficiaries.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows the current Kerala beneficiary database and PM-JAY/KASP criteria.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
